subject: COMPUTER
description: ICSE 10th Computer Applications: Linear Search, Binary Search, Bubble Sort, String Class and Character Methods

questions.question: What does the method "DEVELOPMENT".substring(3, 7) return in Java?
questions.explanation: Indexing starts at 0: indices 3, 4, 5, 6 give characters 'E', 'L', 'O', 'P' ("ELOP").

questions.question: Which search algorithm requires the array elements to be strictly pre-sorted?
questions.explanation: Binary search divides the search interval in half each time and strictly requires sorted arrays.

questions.question: What is the return type of the method Character.isDigit('9') in Java?
questions.explanation: Character wrapper class methods like isDigit(), isLetter() return a boolean.

questions.question: What is the result of "Computer".compareTo("Computer")?
questions.explanation: compareTo() returns 0 if both strings are lexicographically identical.

questions.question: If int arr[] = new int[10], what is the valid index range for this array?
questions.explanation: Java arrays are zero-indexed, so an array of size 10 has valid indices from 0 up to 9.
